name: antigravity-orbit
description: Switch orbits in a single click. Seamless, isolated developer profiles and sandboxed workspaces for Google Antigravity IDE.

antigravity-orbit.autoRestoreLastProfile.description: Automatically restore and open the last active orbit profile when launching Antigravity IDE.

enumDescriptions: Always ask whether to switch in-place or open in a new window.
Always switch in-place (transfer current workspace and close window).
Always launch an isolated new window alongside the current session.
antigravity-orbit.defaultLaunchMode.description: Default action when selecting or launching a profile.

antigravity-orbit.confirmDelete.description: Prompt for confirmation before permanently deleting custom profiles.

antigravity-orbit.showStatusBarItem.description: Show the active Orbit profile indicator in the bottom status bar.

antigravity-orbit.statusBarAlignment.description: Alignment position of the Orbit status bar indicator.

antigravity-orbit.autoSyncExtension.description: Automatically synchronize and propagate the Orbit extension to all custom profiles on startup.

antigravity-orbit.closeAfterSwitch.description: Automatically close the current window when switching profiles in switch mode.
